fieldValues.title: FieldAssignment.displayLabel and FieldAssignment.displayHint are for…
fieldValues.normative_statement: `FieldAssignment.displayLabel` and `FieldAssignment.displayHint` are for rendering only. They must not affect AI guidance, extraction logic, `fieldType` interpretation, or validation. Extended by RFC-036 [CR-036-20]: they must also not affect a Record's Relations or its Discovery Text Projection (`ext:discovery`). Two repositories differing only in these values must produce identical validation results and identical Discovery output.
